name: Mobile Application Data Analysis
description: Ability to extract and analyse data from mobile applications including messaging apps (WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram), social media, browsers, email clients, and third-party applications. Covers SQLite database parsing, plist and protobuf decoding, deleted message recovery, and understanding application-specific data storage patterns.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to mobile application data analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands that mobile applications store forensically relevant data and knows common data storage formats
evidence: Can describe common mobile app data storage formats (SQLite, plist, protobuf, XML)
Understands the concept of app sandboxing and how it affects data location
Can explain why messaging app data is often critical in investigations

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Extracts and examines app data from common applications using forensic tools under supervision
evidence: Extracted and parsed WhatsApp and Telegram databases from acquired devices under guidance
Queried SQLite databases to recover chat messages, contacts, and media references
Examined browser history, bookmarks, and cached data from mobile browser app data
Documented application data findings with supervisor review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyses application data across a range of apps to answer investigative questions and produces court-ready reports
evidence: Independently analysed app data in 5+ investigations across messaging, social media, and financial apps
Recovered deleted messages and media from SQLite databases using WAL and journal analysis
Correctly interpreted application-specific timestamps, status indicators, and metadata
Produced app data analysis reports that met evidentiary standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles encrypted and obfuscated app data; reverse-engineers undocumented storage formats; develops custom parsing tools
evidence: Decrypted application databases and backups using extracted keys (e.g. Signal's SQLCipher database, WhatsApp crypt14/crypt15 backups)
Reverse-engineered undocumented or proprietary app data storage formats
Developed custom parsing scripts for apps not supported by commercial tools
Reviews app data analysis work and mentors junior examiners

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines app data analysis methodology; researches new application artifacts; validates tool parsing accuracy
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's mobile application data analysis procedures
Published research on application artifact discovery or parsing techniques
Validated commercial tool parsing accuracy against manual analysis for key applications
Trains teams on mobile application data analysis and provides expert testimony

assessment_methods.description: Given a mobile device extraction, analyse messaging app databases, recover deleted content, and produce an evidence report with message timelines
Review app data analysis sections from recent case reports for parsing accuracy and completeness
